senior-customer-succes-manager.description:
About Workspace 365

Everything simplified. Workspace 365 is the intelligent workspace that brings everything together. One central starting point where employees automatically get what they need. Kelly, our digital colleague, makes that workspace even smarter. She helps employees find answers faster and pick up tasks. Calm, focus and overview in your working day.

For that, we need people like you. People who want to make a difference.

The role: Senior Customer Success Manager

  • You are the sparring partner for our most complex and valuable customers. You manage your own portfolio of 50 to 60 large accounts.

  • You help organisations get real value from Workspace 365. You advise C-level on how to bring calm, focus and overview back into their working day, and you turn that value into more usage, expansion and revenue. Customers stay enthusiastic, their contract grows with them, and you bring the insights you gather back to our product team. You are the voice of the customer at the table.

  • At the same time, you set the example for junior and medior CSMs in the team and share your expertise with them. You set the standard for what good customer success looks like, and you make our approach smarter, stronger and scalable.

You are responsible for

  • Reducing churn and identifying and converting upsell opportunities in your portfolio, so customers do not just stay, but grow.

  • Running complex onboardings independently and managing your own portfolio of 50 to 60 large, direct customers with a high MRR per customer.

  • Leading strategic customer conversations at C-level and thinking along on complex questions.

  • Advising customers on how to use Kelly, our digital colleague, to increase adoption and value within their organisation.

  • Spotting opportunities to improve the product and feeding the roadmap with customer insights.

  • Setting the example for junior and medior CSMs and raising the standard for the team.

  • Representing Customer Success to internal leadership and external partners.
senior-customer-succes-manager.requirements:
This is who you are

You take full responsibility, raise the bar and grab opportunities when you see them. You learn from others, follow market trends and apply them. You see patterns, make complexity simple and push for continuous improvement.

This is what you bring

  • At least 5 years of experience in customer-facing roles within SaaS

  • A bachelor's degree or higher

  • Fluent Dutch and English, and you lead communication at organisation level in both languages

  • An understanding of how you guide customers from onboarding, through value, to growth.

  • A network and experience in customer advisory boards or strategic account management.

  • A sharp mix of empathy for the customer and a nose for commercial opportunities.

What you get

  • Salary: €4,800 to €6,300 gross + bonus

  • Lease car, laptop, phone

  • €1,000 training budget per year

  • 25 holiday days + 1 extra 'You Day' per quarter if you are not off sick!

  • Lunch together. Every day.

  • A cosy office in Nijkerk (yes, including a ping pong table, table football, Mario Kart and even a meditation room and little library)

  • A culture that feels almost like a close group of friends, not like a company. You really know your colleagues, and they know you.

Ready to get to know each other?

We are happy to have a coffee with you if we think there is a match.

Questions? Call or WhatsApp Julia on +31 6 11753348 or email julia.vbergen@workspace365.net

See you soon 🚀

Unsolicited agency contact is not welcome. We prefer to find our new colleague ourselves.

senior-sales-development-representative.description:
Are you ready to not only open deals, but also make the team better?

As a Senior SDR at Workspace 365, you help organisations with their digital transformation. But you do more than hit quota. You are the voice that sharpens the team. The experience juniors learn from. The person who sees how it can be better and makes it better.

About us

Work is often needlessly complicated. Separate systems. Scattered information. Endless searching.

We make work simpler. With our intelligent workspace, we bring everything together in one place. And with our digital colleague Kelly, we make that workspace truly smart. Employees can see, search and ask anything. Kelly retrieves live information from connected systems.

We are growing fast. In the Netherlands and beyond. Especially in healthcare, education and government.

Your role

You are a driving force behind our commercial growth. And it is more than one thing.

You deliver.

  • You open conversations with new organisations

  • You uncover complex IT challenges

  • You qualify prospects sharply and thoughtfully

  • You give strong presentations and first demos

  • You lay the foundation for long-term relationships

You work closely with our Account Executives. Together you take the process to a higher level.

But it does not stop there.

  • You see market trends and translate them into opportunities for us

  • You think along on how we can improve our sales process

  • You coach junior SDRs

You are not just an executor. You help build.

The team

Young. Driven. Competitive.

You work with Axel and the growing SDR team towards shared targets. We celebrate successes together. We learn together too. This is a team under construction, so there is room to make your mark.

"I wanted to grow. The response? 'Fine. Let's make that happen.' You get honest feedback and full support. If you go fast, Workspace 365 goes faster."

Reinier, started as an SDR, now Customer Success Manager

Your development

You work closely with Sales Lead Axel and get room to build your expertise further.

  • Monthly one-to-one conversations

  • Weekly call training sessions

  • €1,000 training budget per year

We expect you to help others grow. And we make sure you keep growing yourself.
senior-sales-development-representative.requirements:
You are an experienced salesperson. You get energy from new business and from making the team better.

In addition:

  • At least 2 years of experience in a commercial B2B or SaaS role

  • You like working with targets

  • You know how to build a good sales conversation

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge

  • You speak good Dutch and English

  • You are available at least 32 hours a week

  • You are results-driven, strategic and entrepreneurial.

What else you can expect

  • 💰 €3,500 to €4,000 gross per month (depending on experience)

  • 📈 Bonus scheme: 90%/10% performance bonus

  • 🏖️ 25 holiday days + 4 You Days

  • 🍽️ Free lunch together every day

  • 🎓 €1,000 training budget per year

  • 🧠 Plenty of freedom and trust

  • 🎉 An informal, driven working atmosphere

We value our company culture highly. Down to earth, relaxed, driven. A place where enjoying your work comes first.

Curious what that looks like in real life? Have a look at our Instagram @workspace.365 or TikTok @life.at.workspace365.

Ready to get to know each other?

We are happy to have a coffee with you if we think there is a match.

Questions? Call or WhatsApp Julia on +31 6 11753348 or email julia.vbergen@workspace365.net

junior-sales-development-representative.description:
You do not want to be a number. Neither do we.

Many employers ask for experience you cannot have yet as a starter. You get turned down for being "too junior", while nobody gives you the chance to show what you can do.

We get that. And we do it differently.

At Workspace 365 you do not start at the bottom of a ladder. From day one you get responsibility and the trust to shape it yourself. That is not an empty promise. It is what our own people tell us when we ask about autonomy and safety in the workplace.

Working and studying

Do you have your mbo diploma (vocational education) and still want to earn a bachelor's degree at a university of applied sciences (hbo)? Then you do not have to choose between a salary and a diploma. With us you combine your job with a part-time hbo programme, and we pay for your studies. Already in the middle of a part-time hbo programme? Then we want to pay for the rest of it. What you learn at school, you apply the next day in a real organisation!

About us

Work is often needlessly complicated: dozens of systems, scattered information, endless searching. We make work simpler. With our intelligent workspace, we bring everything together in one place. Kelly, our digital colleague, makes that workspace even smarter. She retrieves live information from connected systems, so employees can see, search and ask anything.

Our mission? Everything simplified. We are growing fast, in the Netherlands and beyond, especially in healthcare, education and government.

About the role

As an SDR you are the first to start the conversation. You make first contact with organisations, discover where their IT gets stuck and explore whether, and how, Workspace 365 can change that. You do not sell a trick. You sell a solution that really makes work simpler, for people in healthcare, education and government who struggle with this every day.

What you will do:

  • You approach new customers

  • You uncover their challenges

  • You give (online) presentations

  • In demos, you show what Workspace 365 can do, including Kelly, our digital colleague who helps customers find answers faster

What you get here

You own. You do not just get a target, you get the room to decide how to reach it. Your opinion counts from day one. Even if you do not have years of experience yet.

You learn. You help build something bigger than your own numbers: a team that wins together, keeps each other sharp and truly celebrates successes together. You do not get a script to recite here, but coaching to really get better.

You improve. No endless scripts or tricks. Just honestly selling what really works, and always looking at how it can be better and simpler.

"I wanted to grow. The response? 'Good. Let's make that happen.' You get honest feedback and full support here. If you go fast, Workspace 365 goes faster."

Reinier, started as an SDR, now Customer Success Manager
junior-sales-development-representative.requirements:
You do not have to be perfect. Experience is not required either. We do not believe you need years to prove you can do it. But we do look for:

  • Energetic and not afraid of the phone

  • Resilient to a "no" and curious about the "why"

  • Ambitious: you want to learn, improve and win

  • You believe work can be simpler, and want to contribute to that

Our culture is built on: You Learn. You Own. You Improve.

What else you can expect

  • 💰 €2,600 to €3,000 gross per month (depending on experience)

  • 📈 Bonus scheme (up to €400 extra per month)

  • 🏖️ 25 holiday days + 4 You Days

  • 🍽️ Free lunch together every day

  • 🎓 €1,000 training budget per year. Doing a hbo programme at our expense? Then that replaces the training budget.

  • 🧠 Real responsibility and trust

  • 🔍 Kelly, your digital colleague, looks up information for you so you can be on the phone with the customer faster

  • 🎉 An informal, driven working atmosphere

Curious what that looks like in real life? Have a look at our Instagram @workspace.365 or TikTok @life.at.workspace365.

Ready to get to know each other?

We are happy to have a coffee with you if we think there is a match.

meewerkstage-content-marketing.description:
Are you creative, curious and do you enjoy making content? At Workspace 365 you join a small marketing team where you can learn a lot and really contribute.

You work on campaigns, events, social media, email marketing and customer communication. So you do not just watch or come up with ideas. You create and deliver.

What will you do?

As a marketing intern, you help us make Workspace 365 visible to the right audiences. We focus on organisations in healthcare and government, among others. We do that with campaigns, webinars, events, newsletters, content and social media.

For example, you will:

  • create content for social media, newsletters, emails and campaigns;

  • make visuals, presentations, one-pagers or other marketing materials in tools such as Canva;

  • support email marketing and campaigns in HubSpot;

  • join events, campaigns or customer moments to take photos and videos;

  • make and edit short videos for social media or internal campaigns;

  • help with webinars, lunch and learns, conferences and customer events;

  • work on content around themes such as AI in healthcare, digital workplaces and simpler working;

  • contribute to educational content for customers, such as videos or academy content;

  • take on your own internship project where you can use your creativity.

You get plenty of room to create, try and learn. Of course we guide you along the way.

Who are we?

Workspace 365 makes digital work simpler. We bring applications, documents, communication and information together in one digital workspace. That helps employees find what they need faster and do their work more easily.

Our customers are active in healthcare, government and business services, among others. Especially in sectors where employees are already busy enough, we want to make technology simple and accessible.

What do we offer?

You join a committed team where you can learn a lot and quickly become part of the organisation. Because our marketing team is small, you get to see many different parts of marketing.

This is what you can expect:

  • an internship allowance of €500 per month based on 40 hours;

  • good guidance from our marketing team;

  • room for your own internship project;

  • plenty of variety across content, campaigns and events;

  • the chance to work on real marketing activities;

  • room to use your creativity;

  • a pleasant atmosphere with colleagues who like to help each other;

  • free lunch at the office;

  • a bootcamp at the office every Thursday at 16:15;

  • room to develop yourself.
meewerkstage-content-marketing.requirements:
You are following a hbo programme (university of applied sciences) in Marketing, Communication, Creative Business, Commercial Economics, Media, Design or something similar. Above all, we are looking for someone who likes to make things. Someone who gets energy from creating, brings new ideas and enjoys making visible results.

Are you following a mbo programme (vocational education) instead and do you think this internship suits you? Then we invite you to apply too.

You also recognise yourself in this:

  • you are creative and enjoy making content;

  • you are interested in social media, video, campaigns, events or email marketing;

  • you like to work together and dare to ask questions;

  • you can keep an overview and keep your agreements;

  • you enjoy not just coming up with ideas, but also carrying them out;

  • you are available 3 to 5 days a week

  • Experience with Canva, HubSpot, email marketing, social media or video is a plus. Not a must, because you are here to learn too!

Are you our new intern and future colleague? Apply right away! Do you have questions? Contact Julia, Corporate Recruiter, at julia.vbergen@workspace365.net or call +31 6 11753348. See you soon!
